provenance.source: Terrarium elevation tiles (AWS Terrain Tiles / Mapzen)
provenance.provider: Mapzen / Linux Foundation Terrain Tiles on AWS (blend of USGS 3DEP and other sources)
provenance.license: Terrain Tiles attribution (https://github.com/tilezen/joerd/blob/master/docs/attribution.md); USGS 3DEP is public domain
provenance.crs: EPSG:3857 tiles, sampled at substrate grid cell centres
provenance.method: Bilinear sample (the app's sampleTerrarium) at the centre of every 16 m cell of the substrate grid over the coverage, row-major from the north row, stored as integer centimetres. Grid west/south 19967.998 / 23040.001 m.
caveats: Terrarium blends sources and includes bathymetry; along NYC shorelines it contains artefacts down to −14 km (routing/R3).
Nominal z15 pixel is about 3.6 m at this latitude; the underlying source resolution varies by place.
Vertical datum is not stated per tile by the provider.
